text:
maria: Quick update — I brought up Llama2-13B-q8 on EU-H100 and US-H100 and did a fast kernel sweep (flashv2, flashv3, triton, vendor-cu). Pasted the trimmed numbers below. Trying to decide a safe switchover heuristic for flashv3.

maria: ```
# p50 / p95 latency (ms) and tokens/sec @ seq=512
# batch=1  batch=8  batch=32
EU-H100 (flashv2):  45 / 120   | 22 / 48   | 9 / 18  | 170 tok/s @32
EU-H100 (flashv3):  42 / 140   | 20 / 46   | 8 / 16  | 195 tok/s @32
US-H100 (triton):   50 / 110   | 24 / 46   | 10 / 19 | 160 tok/s @32
US-H100 (vendor):   48 / 130   | 23 / 50   | 9.5 / 20| 180 tok/s @32

# notes: flashv3 gives better throughput at high batch but p95 regresses on small-batch in EU.
```

maria: Any quick takes on safety margins / hysteresis before we flip routing?

sahil: did you run the eval set after q8 quant? quality regressions?

zoe: ran our conv-eval (2k prompts). flashv3+q8 -> 0.4% ROUGE drop on long-context prompts (>1024). short-context <0.2%. not huge but visible.

amanda: saw microburst tail on flashv3 batch=1 in EU — p95 jumped to ~220ms for a handful of requests. Logs show multiple small warmups:```
# warmup snippet
2026-03-19T12:34:22Z warmup start seq=512
2026-03-19T12:34:22Z nvml: power-step 1 -> 2
2026-03-19T12:34:22Z kernel: flashv3 init ms=18
```

henry: my vote: conservative rule: prefer flashv3 for batch >= 8 AND seq <= 512. For batch <= 2 or seq > 1024 prefer triton/vendor. Add hysteresis: require 3 consecutive evaluation windows before switching.

kevin: cost angle — flashv3 improved tokens/sec by ~15% at batch=32 (EU), but EU GPU egress/region premium adds ~10% to unit cost, so net savings are small for low-util cases. interesting win only when we can consolidate into larger batches.

maria: sounds reasonable. also want an automatic rollback if eval quality delta > 0.5% on any critical promptset.

infra-bot: @maria scheduled a canary experiment: kernel-safety-probation-2839991234 (EU & US, 2h windows, collect perf+eval). run id=exp-20260319-004 :gear:

eval-bot: kicked off quality jobs against conv-eval + safety-checklist. reports will land in /evals/exp-20260319-004 (perf + rouge + hallucination checks) :eyes:

maria: sweet. TL;DR — flashv3 ok to promote for high-batch short-seq use, hold off for small-batch or long-context until we fix warmup tail and confirm <0.5% quality drift. we'll reconvene after the canary. :thumbsup:
